You will collaborate with product, engineering, policy, and business teams to deliver data-driven solutions, apply AI-enabled capabilities, and ensure data quality, security, and compliance across GovTech platforms.

RSM Singapore is seeking an Associate, Full-Stack Engineer to join our Data Science team in Singapore. You will build, test and support web applications across frontend, backend and database within a small team, turning audit requirements into practical software.

You will work with Django or FastAPI, React or Next.js, and collaborate closely with data and AI engineers, while following secure coding and CI/CD practices. Fresh graduates with relevant projects are encouraged to apply.
